column1: review
Absolutely love these earphones! The sound is crystal clear and the bass is amazing.
Best purchase I've made this year. Battery lasts all day and they fit perfectly.
So happy with this product, my whole family wants a pair now.
Great value for money. Pairing with my phone took two seconds.
I use them every morning on my run and they never fall out. Fantastic!
Superb noise cancellation, I can finally focus on the metro.
The left earbud stopped working after just two weeks. Very disappointed.
I had high hopes but the sound quality is quite average. Sad I spent this much.
Expected much better from this brand. Feels cheap and the case scratches easily.
Returned them. They just didn't live up to the reviews and I feel let down.
Worst customer service ever! I've emailed five times and nobody replies.
Delivery was a week late and the box was damaged. Totally unacceptable!
They charged my card twice and refuse to refund me. I am furious.
The app keeps crashing and disconnecting my earphones. So frustrating!
The ear tips smelled strange and felt sticky when I opened the box. Gross.
Found hair inside the charging case on arrival. Disgusting quality control.
The case gets really hot while charging. I'm worried it might catch fire.
Is this even an original product? The packaging looks fake and I'm scared I got scammed.
I'm nervous about the battery swelling, there's a small bulge on one earbud already.
Wow, I didn't expect such good sound at this price!
Surprisingly they work with my old laptop too, I had no idea.
I was shocked to find they are waterproof, they survived the washing machine!
Received the product on Tuesday. It comes in black and white colours.
The box includes three sizes of ear tips and a USB-C cable.
Battery life is around 6 hours with the case giving 3 more charges.
Comfortable for long calls at work. Mic quality is good, colleagues hear me clearly.
Decent earphones, does the job for daily use.
Very upset that the touch controls stopped responding after a month.
Why does the volume randomly jump to maximum? This hurts my ears and it's ridiculous!
Gifted these to my sister and she was thrilled. Thank you!
